summary: A full interactive single-page website for the CHE110 eco-anxiety college project. Features: sticky navigation, hero intro with LPU branding and team photos, animated stat counters, the Problem section with eco-anxiety definition, interactive flip cards for Causes, solution pillars with animated checklist, 3-step Implementation timeline, and a team section. All sections match the video script structure. Dark eco-green themed with floating leaf animations and scroll-triggered effects.
